chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Jaʿfar, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would not touch except the Black Corner and the Yemeni Corner; he would kiss them both and place his cheek upon them, and I saw my father doing that.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to the Imam’s father عليه السلام
key_terms.الرُّكْنَ الْأَسْوَدَ: the Black Corner of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.الْيَمَانِيَّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.يَسْتَلِمُ: to touch or make ritual contact with a corner of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.يُقَبِّلُهُمَا: he would kiss both of them

ai.seo_question: Which corners of the Kaʿbah did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to touch and kiss during tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in touching specifically the Black Corner and the Yemeni Corner during tawaf. It also reports that the Imam’s father عليه السلام acted in the same way, showing continuity of this sunnah (prophetic tradition).
